600 Tribal Students Leave Maharashtra Hostel Amid 'Possession' Claims

Approximately 600 tribal students have left a residential school in Amravati, Maharashtra. Some students reported that certain girls appeared 'possessed' and heard sounds like anklets clanking. Officials are investigating the cause, with some suspecting mental stress. Separately, a report from Madhya Pradesh mentions 40 tribal hostel girls escaping a facility due to overcrowding and poor food.
